# Praxis Agent OS — Architecture Docs

Five-layer Agent Operating System. Entry point:
docs/architecture/README.md (navigation + generated numbers + design principles).

## Index

- [README.md](README.md): Layer reference index: navigation, numbers snapshot, system overview diagram, reading paths, main data flows, design principles
- [l1-kernel.md](l1-kernel.md): Kernel: process table, sync, event bus, constitution, GateChain G1-G5, port abstractions, 1,027 params constants across 8 modules
- [l2-shell.md](l2-shell.md): Shell: 49 YAML commands + 2 code-registered, i18n, completer, agent selector, dict-in/dict-out handler contract
- [l3-card-lifecycle.md](l3-card-lifecycle.md): Card lifecycle: produce (L3A cardwrite) -> execute (plan/agents/tools) -> approve (GateChain/approval gate) -> complete -> R4 archive, with state diagram
- [l3-memory.md](l3-memory.md): Memory: 4 rings + side-channels (Mer symbolization, R5 graph, user profile) + system-prompt injection, with Mer pipeline diagram
- [l3a-central.md](l3a-central.md): L3A decision layer: sessions, l3a_ask clarification, cardwrite, profile consumption, session/ask state machines, session contract endpoints
- [l3-tools.md](l3-tools.md): Tool layer: 20 implementations by domain + tool system (spec/registry/policy/9-step pipeline)
- [l3-cell-os.md](l3-cell-os.md): Cell runtime: 20 SoC components (I-Cache, MMU, PMU, Watchdog, Interrupt, Rollback, Permission...) + boot/install/lifecycle/wiring
- [l3-scheduler.md](l3-scheduler.md): Scheduler: 5D matrix (route/pool/time/rate/scope) + ACB + safety layers (loop detectors, sequence monitor, think registry)
- [l3-convention.md](l3-convention.md): Cross-cell deliberation: orchestrator -> answer sessions -> aggregator -> supplements -> report, with flow diagram
- [l4-bridge.md](l4-bridge.md): Bridge: 334 routes, API gateway, LLM engine, SSE/WS/RPC channels, auth/fs contracts, sandbox, with message/auth sequences
- [l5-user.md](l5-user.md): User layer: CLI entry, CLI/TUI/desktop contract tiers
- [cross-cutting.md](cross-cutting.md): Cross-cutting: governance, event flow, system-prompt injection switches, session anti-blowup, testing/QA, skills lifecycle, collaboration discipline
